name: clear_selected_object_part_mask_bits

stack.evidence: ScriptCommand_ClearSelectedObjectPartMaskBits consumes two 1-based part indices and passes the selected object and both indices to func_001358B0, which clears the corresponding bits in the object's part masks at offsets 0x38C and 0x390

notes: This is the exact inverse of command 96. The sole JP call passes 1-based part index 2 for both masks after changing the selected object's animation.
